body.name: Extra Loadout Preset Slots
body.description: Save more named action-queue presets to swap between. Presets are shortcuts only — they queue the same actions anyone can queue for free.

body.name: Detailed Personal Report
body.description: A richer personal end-of-day recap with extra charts of YOUR OWN resource/morale trends. Shows nothing hidden about other players.

body.name: Extended Roster Filters
body.description: Extra sort/filter controls on the roster list you can already see. Pure UI convenience.

body.name: Extended Report History
body.description: Keep more past days of your own reports scrollable in the client. Informational only.
